text: At a psychiatric ward in Newark, the therapist Rose Cotter watches a new patient [smile and cut her own throat|trigger|seeing or hearing too much]. Soon Rose sees smiling strangers everywhere, her cat turns up dead inside her nephew's birthday present, and her sister blames their mother's illness. With her ex-boyfriend Joel, a detective, Rose traces [a chain of suicides, each witnessed by the next|rules|it passes to others], every victim [dead within a week|rules|death on a deadline], and learns of [an entity that feeds on trauma|wants|feeding on the living].
